# Project Context

Copilot does not import files. Read these when relevant to the task:

- Product vision: `docs/product.md`
- Project structure: `docs/structure.md`
- Tech stack, build and test commands: `docs/tech.md`

# Specs

Features are cut into one folder each: `specs/<feature-name>/`.
Path-specific rules for working in them are in `.github/instructions/specs.instructions.md`.
